parole.significato: A source of great wealth, especially a mine.
parole.testo: From Urdu گولْکُنْڈَہ (golkunḍa), itself from Telugu గొల్లకొండ (gollakoṇḍa), from గొల్ల (golla, “of or pertaining to shepherds”) + కొండ (koṇḍa, “hill”).

parole.significato: Synonym of dak (“post system by means of relays of horses carrying mail and passengers”).
parole.testo: Borrowed from Urdu ٹَپّال (ṭappāl) (Deccani), from Telugu టపాలు (ṭapālu).
